basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and tech enthusiast from Mendoza, Argentina. I recently got my first PS4 and am diving deep into the world of gaming and console customization. I have a background in graphic design, which fuels my interest in high-quality visuals and custom wallpapers. My day job is as a junior graphic designer at a local firm, and I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, typically between 6 PM and 11 PM. I'm single and enjoy spending my free time exploring new games and learning about tech gadgets.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in graphic design from a local university and have always been fascinated by digital art and technology. My knowledge of gaming and tech comes from a combination of my educational background and self-teaching through online tutorials and forums. I often seek advice from more experienced gamers and tech enthusiasts on Reddit.
